episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses innovative strategies for real estate agents to leverage past clients with low-interest rates. He introduces the concept of turning properties into rentals, using bridge loans to eliminate contingencies, and accessing home equity through HELOCs. The episode provides actionable insights and tools to help agents unlock new opportunities and grow their business.
